C. Dynamic proxies (@ProxyMethod hooks) vs the phone's interfaces
   NOT ON PHONE = the hook never fires, so that call is not virtualized.
   ARG>=N = the hook reads args[i] past the phone's parameter count.
   CAST = the hook casts args[i] to a type the phone does not pass there.
